checks.name: Order not expired
checks.description: Block timestamp is at or before the order's orderExpiry field.

checks.name: Not a replay
checks.description: The order hash has not been submitted before (usedOrders mapping).

checks.name: Signatures recovered
checks.description: Every signature in the array recovers to a valid non-zero address.

checks.name: No duplicate signers
checks.description: All recovered signer addresses are distinct.

checks.name: Signers in registry
checks.description: Every recovered signer is active in the CourtKeyRegistry.

checks.name: Keys within validity window
checks.description: Block timestamp is between validFrom and validUntil for every signer.

checks.name: Territorial jurisdiction
checks.description: Each JUDGE and CLERK signer's territory matches or is a parent of the parcel's territory. REGISTRAR is exempt (national authority).

checks.name: Judge present
checks.description: At least one signer holds ROLE_JUDGE.

checks.name: Clerk present
checks.description: At least one signer holds ROLE_CLERK.

checks.name: Nonce valid
checks.description: The provided nonce equals the primary judge's current judgeNonce counter.

checks.name: Pecuniary jurisdiction
checks.description: The parcel's declared value does not exceed the judge's court-level maximum.

checks.name: Token is frozen
checks.description: The parcel token is currently frozen. Required before an unfreeze order can be accepted.

checks.name: Registrar present
checks.description: At least one signer holds ROLE_REGISTRAR.
